notes: Canonical prerender metadata table. Scripts (scripts/prerender.mjs, scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs) and the src/app/seo contract tests read THIS file, so a contract change only needs to move here once.

Entries with source 'wave8-fix' deliberately repair the frozen stale-metadata defects recorded in contracts/routes.json (activity, admin/*). The exact frozen values are kept in frozenStale so the Lead can update contracts/seo-pwa.json and the parity allowlist with a documented exception.

StructuredData is the exact JSON-LD graph the frozen SEOHead presets rendered (structuredDataCount in contracts/content/rendered/*.json); routes whose snapshots recorded structuredDataCount 0 keep structuredData null.
{{SITE_URL}} is replaced with the production origin at generate time (default: siteUrl below).

shellHeading is the boot-shell heading rendered inside #root before JS runs (LCP only). Public routes ship a shell; admin/guest-token/404 do not. createRoot replaces the shell on mount, so it never reaches the post-hydration parity capture.
